courses.summary: 田吉茲的公開架構包含油氣分離與含硫氣體處理；教學只研究質量、能源和量測邊界。本課依序分析多產品分離邊界、處理廠熱整合、油氣與副產品對帳、共用設備故障影響、含硫環境的檢驗證據，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Tengiz publicly describes separation and sour-gas processing; teaching is limited to mass, energy and measurement boundaries. The course analyses multi-product separation boundary, processing-plant heat integration, oil gas and by-product reconciliation, effects of shared-equipment outages, inspection evidence for sour-service environments, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
